name: docling
description: Get your documents ready for gen AI
one_liner: Turns messy real-world documents — PDFs, Word files, scanned contracts, spreadsheets, even audio and video — into clean, structured text that an AI system can actually read and understand.
buyer: An operations lead at a law firm or insurance company who has thousands of scanned contracts or claims PDFs sitting unsearchable in a shared drive.
business_use_cases: A law firm digitizes decades of scanned contracts into searchable, structured text for an internal AI research assistant.
An insurance company automatically converts incoming claims PDFs and emails into structured data for faster claims processing.
A RAG-chatbot vendor uses it as the ingestion layer so their AI can actually answer questions about a client's uploaded documents accurately.

money_ideas.idea: Run it as a hosted document-ingestion API and charge per page/document processed.
Build a vertical SaaS on top for a specific industry (legal, insurance, healthcare records) with a monthly seat price.
One-off integration projects wiring a client's document pile into their existing AI chatbot or search tool.

steal_this: Build a simple 'drag in your PDFs, get clean searchable text out' web app this weekend and sell it to one local small business (accountant, law office) drowning in paper.
